نتلازم (form VI)
# نَتَلَازَمُ (natalāzamu) /na.ta.laː.za.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# نَتَلَازَمَ (natalāzama) /na.ta.laː.za.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
# نَتَلَازَمْ (natalāzam) /na.ta.laː.zam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَازَمَ (talāzama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
